description_en: Releases the public domain name for a Mem0 instance
description_zh: 为 Mem0 实例释放公网域名
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx release-mem0-public-connection --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-htri00000r4k9p --current-connection-string pxc-hzjasdyuoo.polarx.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ReleaseMem0PublicConnection

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196841~~) operation to query the details of regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs.
parameters.description_zh: 实例所在地域id。>您可以调用[describeregions](~~196841~~)接口查看polardb-x支持的地域详情，包括地域id。
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. > You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196841.html operation to query the details of regions supported by PolarDB-X, including region IDs

parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The public endpoint to be released. This parameter is optional. If this parameter is not specified, the public endpoint of Mem0 is automatically released.
